plainformDesign.source:
Design a warship called Patrol Corvette with id entity/corvette using the right-up-forward design frame.
Create a symmetric smooth profile called hull section through [0 metres right, 4.6 metres up], [6.5 metres right, 4.35 metres up], [6.7 metres right, 2.8 metres up], [6.4 metres right, 0 metres up], [5.6 metres right, 2.0 metres down], [3.0 metres right, 3.15 metres down], [0 metres right, 3.4 metres down], mirrored across the up centreline.
Smooth profile hull section with 36 samples.
Add a controlled section of hull section at 44 metres backward, width 11.6 metres, height 7.2 metres, offset vertically by 10 centimetres.
Add a controlled section of hull section at 32 metres backward, width 12.8 metres, height 7.7 metres.
Add a controlled section of hull section at 16 metres backward, width 13.2 metres, height 8.0 metres.
Add a controlled section of hull section at 1 metre backward, width 13.2 metres, height 8.0 metres.
Add a controlled section of hull section at 16 metres forward, width 12.6 metres, height 8.3 metres, offset vertically by 25 centimetres.
Add a controlled section of hull section at 30 metres forward, width 8.8 metres, height 8.8 metres, offset vertically by 70 centimetres.
Add a controlled section of hull section at 40 metres forward, width 4.6 metres, height 9.2 metres, offset vertically by 1.2 metres.
Add a controlled section of hull section at 45 metres forward, width 1.1 metres, height 9.8 metres, offset vertically by 1.7 metres.
Create a smooth guide curve called sheer line through [5.8 metres right, 4.2 metres up, 44 metres backward], [6.5 metres right, 4.45 metres up, 16 metres backward], [6.4 metres right, 4.6 metres up, 1 metre backward], [4.4 metres right, 5.5 metres up, 30 metres forward], [1.6 metres right, 6.9 metres up, 42 metres forward], [0.25 metres right, 7.8 metres up, 45 metres forward].
Create a smooth guide curve called keel line through [0 metres right, 3.4 metres down, 44 metres backward], [0 metres right, 3.4 metres down, 1 metre backward], [0 metres right, 3.3 metres down, 30 metres forward], [0 metres right, 1.8 metres down, 42 metres forward], [0 metres right, 0.3 metres up, 45.2 metres forward].
Loft a watertight solid called Hull with id entity/hull through all sections of hull section, with 2 cap rings, following sheer line and keel line, with positional continuity, using material material/hull-haze.
Preview these changes.
